mechanism: Combination of tricyclic antidepressant with MAOI causes excessive serotonergic and noradrenergic stimulation, leading to serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis due to inhibition of monoamine metabolism.
action: This combination is contraindicated; amitriptyline must be discontinued for at least 5 days before initiating isocarboxazid, or isocarboxazid must be stopped for at least 2 weeks before starting amitriptyline.
